vibeplayer.chat.drag: Hover + hold Ctrl to move · click the cover for the player
vibeplayer.player.title: Vibe Player
vibeplayer.player.source.tooltip: Which app to follow. Auto: the one Windows shows in the media flyout. Click to cycle through the apps that play.
vibeplayer.config.title: Vibe Player — Settings
vibeplayer.config.hud.tooltip: Show the "now playing" card while you play. In chat it is always shown, with the controls.
vibeplayer.config.style.tooltip: Card: cover, track, progress. Compact: one small line.
vibeplayer.config.position.tooltip: Where the card is. You can also drag it with the mouse while chat is open.
vibeplayer.config.accent.tooltip: Colour of the progress bar and the glow. "From the cover" picks it from the album art.
vibeplayer.config.scale.tooltip: Card size relative to the interface.
vibeplayer.config.opacity.tooltip: How dark the card background is.
vibeplayer.config.hide_paused.tooltip: Hide the card while the music is paused.
vibeplayer.config.cover.tooltip: Show the album cover / video thumbnail.
vibeplayer.config.progress.tooltip: Progress bar with the time. In chat, click it to seek.
vibeplayer.config.app.tooltip: Show where the music plays: Spotify, Chrome, Yandex…
vibeplayer.config.equalizer.tooltip: Animated bars while the music plays.
vibeplayer.config.marquee.tooltip: Long titles scroll instead of being cut.
vibeplayer.config.hide_idle.tooltip: No card when no player is open. Off: the card says "Nothing is playing".
vibeplayer.config.restart.tooltip: Restart the connection to the system media controls.
vibeplayer.status.unsupported: This system is not supported (Windows, or Linux with playerctl)
vibeplayer.preview.title: Your favourite track
